passed: 288 actual old/new fights preserve boss HP/rewards; every fight ends, and Trio/Bingle entire fight statistics remain identical at all upgrades and120/60Hz.
64 twelve-second cases cover four bosses×upgrades0/1/3/5×120/60Hz×old/new; enemy traces match exactly, first-shot timing matches, and Tanko volleys/projectiles decrease.

Every emitted bullet is accounted for as blocked, player-reached, passed/expired, or still flying; native HP/invulnerability remains active, and a deliberately unblocked shot calibrates reached1/damage1/HP9→8 in each version.
Requested defense metrics and normal-HP TTK are recorded for both time steps; no extra balance adjustment is applied when frontal defense remains strong.

method.aim: Stationary player, centre aim refreshed each tick, fixed random. Existing1.5s boss transition included; first trigger at first update with zero initial cooldown.
method.ttk: Actual previous/current pages, normal spawn HP, invulnerable player for reproducible uninterrupted TTK; all3 characters/upgrades0..5/four regions.
method.defense: 12s for each boss at upgrades0/1/3/5. Test-only boss HP1e6 keeps it alive. Tanko starts with actual9HP and normal hurt/invulnerability; no invulnerability override during defense. Enemy timestamps/positions/velocities/radii/lifetimes must match exactly.
method.volleys: One invocation of shoot(); generated projectiles also counted, since upgrades3/5 create two per volley.
method.reached: An actual enemy-circle/player hit, counted even during native invulnerability; HP damage events recorded separately.
method.passed: Neither intercepted nor player-reached, and removed by arena bounds/lifetime before12s. Still-flying at12s is separate. emitted=blocked+reached+passed+flying.

limits: Controlled Chromium simulation, not physical Galaxy/Samsung Internet performance or human aim.
